description: Where the human checks and steers what agents did: what waits on them, what changed in code, who worked on what.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: One queue of what waits on the human, ordered by value, turns review and human-dependent ideas into a short daily task instead of a hunt.
Seeing the code diff behind an idea lets a human check what an agent actually did before accepting it, which makes review a judgment of the work rather than of its summary.
Knowing which person or agent worked on an idea tells the human whom to ask and whose work to check.
